segments.name: Biopharmaceutical
segments.description: A developmental stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapeutics, including psychedelic formulations, for PTSD, fibromyalgia, Alzheimer's and CNS diseases.
segments.evidence: We are currently focusing on four product candidates: 1. SPC-15 for stress-indued psychiatric disorders, including PTSD and anxiety. 2. SP-26 for treatments of fibromyalgia and chronic pain. 3. SPC-14 for treatment of Alzheimer's disease. 4. SPU-16 for CNS disorders, initially targeting multiple sclerosis.

changes.text: In 2025 the company's strategy changed to include a cryptocurrency treasury strategy focused on acquiring leading digital assets.
changes.evidence: Our strategy changed to include cryptocurrency treasury strategy in August 2025 to focus on the acquisition of leading digital assets.
